_description: Phase 5 — Classification of 9 non-canonical journey types from 22 legacy whatsapp-mock-generator client projects. Cap: at most 3 new journey modules; the rest are aliases of canonical journeys.

classifications.reason: Daily rate broadcast is a campaign message broadcast — fits campaigns_queries which already handles push-broadcast journeys. No unique screen types needed.
Customer group setup + enquiry routing mirrors dealer engagement (group enrollment + communication). 7 steps with no unique screen patterns.
Customer DM to sales exec + internal group routing + quote delivery — this is a query-and-response flow identical in structure to campaigns_queries.
Ticket creation, team updates, customer notification — this is post-order/post-service communication. Same notification + document flow as post_order_communication.
Order submission, order history nav, invoice, cash discount, payment received — this IS order_to_cash with ERP integration emphasis. 5 steps, same screen types.
DSR (Daily Sales Report) expense claim = field_ops_expense with a different label. Same step structure.
Plumber registration = retailer onboarding with a different partner label. Same step structure.
Retailer ordering journey = order_to_cash for an agri brand. No unique screen types.
Collections finance with PTP (Promise to Pay) incentives = automated_collections with incentive messaging. Same step structure.
Seller side of scrap trade: nudge to list, draft listing, review, publish. Merged with scrap_procurement into single scrap_trade module (buyer + seller in one journey type). 26 screens.
Buyer side of scrap trade: create PO, PO list, broadcast, confirmation. Aliased to scrap_trade journey type (same module, buyer perspective). 29 screens.

Discovery → Consideration → Installation → Support lifecycle for solar customers. Sidebar-based layout (8 steps with sbstep-N IDs) — different DOM pattern from all others. No canonical has this lifecycle flow.
Industrial IoT defect alert via WhatsApp group — alert raised, team dispatched, fix verified. 4 steps with sidebar layout. Unique to industrial IoT use case.

_summary._note: Cap of 3 honored. scrap_marketplace + scrap_procurement merged into scrap_trade (seller + buyer in one module).
